assets.name: weather-ridge.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original background terrain tile for chapter 7 of a portrait top-down anime aircraft shooter.
Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its soft gouache/anime background painting, broad organic brush-shaped color masses, simplified tiny industrial buildings, gentle value groups, thin side faces and aerial near-overhead scale. Do not copy its island outline or sunny green coastal setting.
Redraw the storm-front environment in that coherent painted style. High-altitude 80-85 degree downward camera, no horizon. Cool slate blue rocks with muted sage alpine vegetation, small ivory and petrol-blue weather structures physically supported on stone platforms, hints of warm cream edge light and subdued yellow safety markings. Ominous blue-gray storm-cloud banks have broad hand-painted flat facets and soft broken edges, not realistic volumetric render or smoky noise. Terrain and structures are well below the player's aircraft. No aircraft, characters, icons, UI, text, watermark, satellites, outer space, neon, thick outlines, tiny greebles, photorealistic textures or 3D plastic shading.
Tall portrait 1024x1536 tile. Objects predominantly in outer left 0-28% and right 76-100%; keep the central half empty of terrain for readable combat. Vary heights and silhouettes naturally rather than a symmetric canyon. Every structure stays attached to rock. True transparent alpha outside terrain/cloud shapes, including a large clear central opening. No black painted backdrop, no opaque rectangle, no checkerboard. Soft feathered alpha only at cloud edges. Top and bottom edges fade terrain/cloud objects out within 90px so the tile can scroll into another layout without hard seams.
Composition: a single broad, irregular weather-monitoring headland enters from the LEFT in the upper-middle third, with a tiny low radar dome, 2 blue-roof sheds and a curved access road. A few slate terraces and pale grasses, sparse cloud wisps wrap only the outside foot of rock. On the RIGHT at the lower third a narrower broken mountain crest with a lone little radio mast. Sparse dark cloud lobes at the two outside corners. Keep 60% actual transparent opening.

assets.name: storm-sea.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless far background for a vertical-scrolling anime aircraft shooter, chapter 7 storm-front. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: broad gentle gouache brushwork, organic color patches, hand-painted scenery, no realistic rendering.
Paint a quiet distant cloud sea seen straight down from very high above, no horizon, no land, no buildings. Muted deep desaturated blue-gray with broad irregular layered cloud swirls, slightly lighter slate-blue-gray cloud masses clustered at outside edges. Central half stays calm dark blue-gray so aircraft/projectiles remain clear, but no black empty center and no obvious symmetric corridor. Soft directional brush strokes, subtle large shapes, low contrast, no stars or bright lightning painted in. Dense stormy atmosphere with readable blue rather than near-black. Tall portrait 1024x1536. Opaque full bleed image. Seamlessly tileable vertically; top and bottom same dark slate-blue cloud color/value so wrapping is invisible. No lines, borders, text, icons, watermark, satellites, stars, neon violet, photoreal noise, pixel art, 3D clouds or dramatic white bloom.
